### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to add.

### Motivation / User Value
Why would this feature improve the cybersecurity learning experience? Who benefits from it?

### Detailed Specification
Describe how the feature will work from the user's perspective:
- UI elements (screens, modals, interactive cards, indicators)
- Behavior, user interactions, or styling changes
- How it integrates with existing simulator modules, routes, or state

### Implementation Plan
List the components and files you plan to modify or create:
- [ ] `src/pages/...`
- [ ] `src/components/...`
- [ ] `src/data/...`

---
> ⚠️ **Note for FOSSSoC Participants:** Feature proposals must be reviewed and approved by mentors before coding begins. Mentors will assign `soc-s1` and the appropriate `level:*` difficulty tag (Easy: 10 pts, Medium: 25 pts, Hard: 50 pts).
